summary: IBM's question-answering computer, built to play the quiz show Jeopardy!, where it beat two of the show's greatest champions in 2011. IBM then tried to turn it into a business, above all in medicine, with disappointing results.

events.note: IBM Research takes up the idea of playing Jeopardy!
Wins at Jeopardy! against champions Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter.

events.label: Business unit
events.note: IBM creates a business unit around Watson.

events.label: Health sold
events.note: IBM sells the Watson Health division.

note: Most of its early applications were discontinued and its health division was sold in 2022.
